name: flist-workbench
description: Offline editor for F-list character profiles, with an F-Chat log browser and an MCP server so a local model can drive it.
author: Foundry Blaise <251771510+FoundryBlaise@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.gen:api: npm run api:schema && npm run api:types
scripts.typecheck: npm run api:check && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json
scripts.pack:sidecar: cd sidecar && .venv\Scripts\pyinstaller.exe --onedir --windowed --name sidecar --noconfirm --collect-data certifi --exclude-module pytest --exclude-module _pytest --exclude-module pytest_asyncio --exclude-module pytest_httpx --hidden-import uvicorn.logging --hidden-import uvicorn.loops --hidden-import uvicorn.loops.auto --hidden-import uvicorn.protocols --hidden-import uvicorn.protocols.http --hidden-import uvicorn.protocols.http.auto --hidden-import uvicorn.protocols.websockets --hidden-import uvicorn.protocols.websockets.auto --hidden-import uvicorn.lifespan --hidden-import uvicorn.lifespan.on server.py && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.rmSync('../resources/sidecar',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('dist/sidecar','../resources/sidecar',{recursive:true})"
scripts.pack:win: npm run rebuild:native && npm run build && npm run fetch:extension && npm run pack:sidecar && electron-builder --win --publish never
